paite: Ngai un, dangtak peuhmahte aw, tuite ah hongpai un, dangka neiloute leng; hongpai unla, lei unla ne un! A hi, hongpai unla, uain leh nawitui dangka pe louin, a man leng pe louin lei un.
english: “Come, everyone who thirsts, to the waters! Come, he who has no money, buy, and eat! Yes, come, buy wine and milk without money and without price.

paite: An hilou pi-a bang dinga dangka pai? Niang leh taina lah hi lou-a bang dinga na tha uh pai? Ka thu hoihtakin ngaikhia unla, thil hoih ne un, na hinna uh thil thauin nuamsa hen.
english: Why do you spend money for that which is not bread? and your labor for that which doesn’t satisfy? listen diligently to me, and eat you that which is good, and let your soul delight itself in fatness.

paite: Na bil hondoh unla, ka kiangah hongpai un; ja unla, huchiin na hinna uh a hing ding: huan, na kianguah khantawn thu ka khung ding, David kianga huai hehpihna chiamte.
english: Turn your ear, and come to me; hear, and your soul shall live: and I will make an everlasting covenant with you, even the sure mercies of David.

paite: Ngaiin, mi chih adingin amah palaiin ka sepa, mi chih adingin pipa leh heutuin ka sep ahi.
english: Behold, I have given him for a witness to the peoples, a leader and commander to the peoples.

paite: Ngaiin, na theih ngei louh na sam dinga, nang hon thei ngei lou nam na kiangah hongtai ding uh, Toupa na Pathian jiak leh Israelte Mi Siangthou jiakin; aman lah honpahtawi ngala.
english: Behold, you shall call a nation that you don’t know; and a nation that didn’t know you shall run to you, because of Yahweh your God, and for the Holy One of Israel; for he has glorified you.”

paite: Muh baih dia a om laiin Toupa zong unla, a nai laiin sam un:
english: Seek Yahweh while he may be found; call you on him while he is near:

paite: Mi gilouin a omdan tawpsan henla, mi diktatlouin a ngaihtuahnate tawpsan sam hen: Toupa kiangah kik nawn henla, huchiin aman a na hehpih ding; I Pathian kiang uah kik nawn hen, aman lah ngaidam mahmah sin ngala.
english: let the wicked forsake his way, and the unrighteous man his thoughts; and let him return to Yahweh, and he will have mercy on him; and to our God, for he will abundantly pardon.

paite: Ka ngaihtuahte lah na ngaihtuahte ahi ngal kei a, na omdante leng ka omdan ahi sam kei, Toupan a chi.
english: “For my thoughts are not your thoughts, neither are your ways my ways,” says Yahweh.

paite: Vante lei sanga a sang jaw bangin, ka omdante na omdante uh sangin a sang jaw ngala, ka ngaihtuahte leng na ngaihtuahte uh sangin a sang lai hi.
english: “For as the heavens are higher than the earth, so are my ways higher than your ways, and my thoughts than your thoughts.

paite: Vuah leh vuk bel van akipanin a zu jela, huailamah kik tou ngei kei, lei a vak jaw hi, thil a pousakin a dawn saka, buh chi thehmi kiangah buh chi a piaa, nemi kiangah nekding a pe jel.
english: For as the rain comes down and the snow from the sky, and doesn’t return there, but waters the earth, and makes it bring forth and bud, and gives seed to the sower and bread to the eater;

paite: Huchi mahbangin ka kama kipana ka thu pawt a om ding: bangmah hih neilouin ka kiangah a kik nawn kei dinga, ka deih bang a hihzou zo dinga, thil hih dinga ka sawlnaah leng a lohching ding.
english: so shall my word be that goes forth out of my mouth: it shall not return to me void, but it shall accomplish that which I please, and it shall prosper in the thing I sent it to do.

paite: Nuamsa taka pawtin, lungmuang taka pi khiakin na om sin ngal ua: tang liante leh tang neuten na ma uah la a sa khe guih ding uh, gamlak sing tengtengin leng a khut uh a beng ding uh.Loulingnei tangin meilah a pou zo dinga, khaulingnei tangin mui a pou zo ding: huailah Toupa adinga min hoihna ding leh khantawn chiamtehn hihmana om lou ding ahi ding.
english: For you shall go out with joy, and be led forth with peace: the mountains and the hills shall break forth before you into singing; and all the trees of the fields shall clap their hands.

paite: Loulingnei tangin meilah a pou zo dinga, khaulingnei tangin mui a pou zo ding: huailah Toupa adinga min hoihna ding leh khantawn chiamtehn hihmana om lou ding ahi ding.
english: Instead of the thorn shall come up the fir tree; and instead of the brier shall come up the myrtle tree: and it shall be to Yahweh for a name, for an everlasting sign that shall not be cut off.”
